meta.title: 高质量长难句翻译数据库（中英对照）
meta.description: 面向离线翻译器训练的高质量平行语料库：300条长难句，覆盖10大领域，中英对照。所有语料均为原创撰写，无版权引用问题，可直接用于翻译模型微调、评测与术语研究。
meta.difficulty: 高级（长难句：平均英文词数63，含多重从句、插入语与并列结构）

usage.train: 长难句翻译数据库.jsonl 可直接用于seq2seq/Transformer翻译模型微调；长难句翻译数据库.tsv 适合制表符分隔的通用语料流程
usage.eval: 可按 domain 字段划分评测集，检验模型在各领域的翻译质量

meta.license: 自建原创语料，无版权引用，可用于训练与再发布

data.en: Although the discovery of the Higgs boson in 2012 confirmed the last missing piece of the Standard Model of particle physics, physicists have long suspected that this celebrated theory, for all its predictive power, remains fundamentally incomplete because it offers no explanation for the existence of dark matter or the mysterious preponderance of matter over antimatter in the observable universe.
data.zh: 尽管2012年希格斯玻色子的发现证实了粒子物理标准模型中最后缺失的一块拼图，但物理学家们长期以来一直怀疑：这一备受赞誉的理论尽管预测能力惊人，从根本上说仍不完整，因为它既无法解释暗物质的存在，也无法解释可观测宇宙中物质为何压倒性地多于反物质这一神秘现象。

data.en: While CRISPR-Cas9 gene-editing technology has revolutionized the field of molecular biology by enabling scientists to modify DNA with unprecedented precision, the ethical implications of its application to the human germline, where alterations would be inherited by future generations, continue to provoke intense debate among bioethicists, policymakers, and the public alike.
data.zh: 虽然CRISPR-Cas9基因编辑技术使科学家能够以前所未有的精度修饰DNA，从而彻底改变了分子生物学领域，但将其应用于人类生殖细胞（在此类细胞上的改动将遗传给后代）所引发的伦理问题，依然在生命伦理学家、政策制定者和公众之间激起激烈的争论。

data.en: Despite the remarkable progress that large language models have demonstrated in tasks ranging from machine translation to code generation, critics argue that these systems, which operate by predicting the next token in a sequence based on statistical patterns in their training data, do not possess genuine understanding and can therefore produce confident but entirely fabricated responses.
data.zh: 尽管大型语言模型在从机器翻译到代码生成等任务中展现了惊人的进步，批评者仍指出：这些系统本质上是依据训练数据中的统计模式预测序列中的下一个词元，并不具备真正的理解能力，因而可能给出自信满满却完全凭空捏造的回答。

data.en: In contrast to classical computers, which encode information in binary bits that exist in one of two states at any given moment, quantum computers exploit the principles of superposition and entanglement to process vast numbers of possibilities simultaneously, yet the formidable challenge of maintaining quantum coherence at scale has so far prevented these machines from outperforming their classical counterparts in most practical applications.
data.zh: 与经典计算机（其用二进制比特编码信息，任一时刻比特只处于两种状态之一）不同，量子计算机利用叠加与纠缠原理同时处理海量可能性；然而，在大规模系统中维持量子相干这一艰巨挑战，迄今仍使量子计算机在大多数实际应用中无法胜过经典计算机。

data.en: Although deep neural networks have achieved remarkable success in domains as diverse as image recognition, speech synthesis, and strategic game playing, their reliance on enormous quantities of labeled data and their susceptibility to adversarial examples raise fundamental questions about whether these systems learn true causal structure or merely memorize statistical correlations that fail to generalize beyond their training distribution.
data.zh: 尽管深度神经网络在图像识别、语音合成、策略性博弈等迥然不同的领域取得了显著成就，但它们对海量标注数据的依赖以及对对抗样本的脆弱性，引发了根本性的疑问：这些系统究竟学到了真正的因果结构，还是仅仅记住了无法泛化到训练分布之外的统计相关性。

data.en: Unlike nuclear fission, which splits heavy atoms and produces long-lived radioactive waste that must be isolated for tens of thousands of years, controlled nuclear fusion promises a virtually inexhaustible source of clean energy by fusing light hydrogen isotopes into helium, but decades of research have shown that sustaining the extreme temperatures and pressures required for a net energy gain is an engineering challenge of formidable proportions.
data.zh: 与裂变（将重原子核分裂并产生必须隔离数万年的长寿命放射性废物）不同，受控核聚变通过将轻氢同位素聚合成氦，有望提供几乎取之不尽的清洁能源；然而数十年的研究表明，维持净能量增益所需的高温高压条件，是一项规模极其艰巨的工程挑战。

data.en: When two-dimensional materials such as graphene, a single layer of carbon atoms arranged in a hexagonal lattice, are stacked and twisted at a specific 'magic angle', they can exhibit superconductivity and other exotic electronic properties that were entirely unanticipated by condensed matter physicists, opening up new avenues for quantum device research.
data.zh: 当石墨烯（由碳原子以六边形晶格排列而成的单原子层）等二维材料被堆叠并以特定的“魔角”扭转时，会表现出超导等凝聚态物理学家完全未曾预料的奇异电子性质，为量子器件研究开辟了新的途径。

data.en: The James Webb Space Telescope, which orbits the Sun at the second Lagrange point roughly 1.5 million kilometers from Earth, was designed to observe the universe in the infrared portion of the spectrum, thereby allowing astronomers to peer through clouds of cosmic dust and study the earliest galaxies that formed in the aftermath of the Big Bang.
data.zh: 詹姆斯·韦布空间望远镜在距地球约150万公里的第二拉格朗日点上环绕太阳运行，其设计初衷是以红外波段观测宇宙，从而使天文学家能够穿透宇宙尘埃云，研究大爆炸之后形成的首批星系。

data.en: Whereas conventional industrial robots execute precisely programmed movements in highly controlled factory environments, modern legged robots must contend with unpredictable terrain, dynamic balance, and the continuous integration of noisy sensor data, which together demand control algorithms far more sophisticated than simple trajectory tracking.
data.zh: 传统工业机器人在高度受控的工厂环境中执行精确编程的动作，而现代足式机器人则必须应对不可预测的地形、动态平衡以及嘈杂传感器数据的持续融合，这些共同要求远比简单轨迹跟踪复杂得多的控制算法。

data.en: Although Gordon Moore's famous observation that the number of transistors on a chip doubles roughly every two years has held remarkably well for half a century, the semiconductor industry now confronts fundamental physical limits at the atomic scale, where quantum tunneling effects and heat dissipation threaten to undermine further miniaturization and have prompted a search for alternative computing paradigms.
data.zh: 尽管戈登·摩尔关于芯片上晶体管数量约每两年翻一番的著名论断在半个世纪里惊人地成立，半导体工业如今却在原子尺度上面临根本性的物理极限：量子隧穿效应与散热问题威胁着进一步的微型化，促使业界探寻替代性的计算范式。

data.en: Brain-computer interfaces, which aim to establish direct communication pathways between neural tissue and external devices, hold the promise of restoring mobility to paralyzed patients and augmenting human cognition, yet they raise profound concerns about privacy, identity, and the long-term stability of implanted electrodes in the hostile environment of living brain tissue.
data.zh: 脑机接口旨在神经组织与外部设备之间建立直接的通信通路，有望使瘫痪患者恢复活动能力并增强人类认知，但它也引发了关于隐私、身份认同以及植入电极在脑组织这一苛刻环境中长期稳定性的深刻担忧。

data.en: The development of messenger RNA vaccines against COVID-19, which encode instructions for producing viral spike proteins that trigger protective immune responses, represented a triumph of decades of fundamental research, but their rapid deployment also exposed persistent gaps in global vaccine manufacturing capacity and distribution equity that continue to shape pandemic policy debates.
data.zh: 针对COVID-19的信使核糖核酸疫苗（其编码产生触发保护性免疫反应的病毒刺突蛋白的指令）的研发，是数十年基础研究的胜利；然而其快速部署也暴露了全球疫苗生产能力和分配公平性方面长期存在的差距，这些差距至今仍在塑造着疫情政策辩论。

data.en: Modern climate models, which simulate the coupled behavior of the atmosphere, oceans, ice sheets, and biosphere across timescales ranging from hours to centuries, must balance resolution against computational cost, and the persistent spread among model projections of regional precipitation and extreme weather underscores the deep uncertainty that remains in forecasting the local consequences of global warming.
data.zh: 现代气候模型模拟大气、海洋、冰盖与生物圈在数小时至数百年时间尺度上的耦合行为，必须在分辨率与计算成本之间权衡；各模型对区域降水和极端天气的预测之间持续存在的分歧，凸显了在预测全球变暖的局部后果方面仍然存在的深刻不确定性。

data.en: While lithium-ion batteries have transformed portable electronics and begun to power the electric vehicle revolution, their energy density remains an order of magnitude below that of fossil fuels, and the environmental costs of mining lithium, cobalt, and nickel, together with the challenges of recycling spent cells, cast a shadow over the sustainability of the transition to electrified transportation.
data.zh: 锂离子电池虽然已经改变了便携式电子产品并开启了电动汽车革命，但其能量密度仍比化石燃料低一个数量级；开采锂、钴、镍的环境成本，加上废旧电池回收的难题，为交通运输电气化转型的可持续性蒙上了一层阴影。

data.en: The Internet of Things, which envisions a world in which billions of everyday objects—from refrigerators and thermostats to industrial sensors and medical implants—are connected to the network and communicate autonomously, promises unprecedented convenience and efficiency but simultaneously expands the attack surface available to malicious actors seeking to compromise critical infrastructure.
data.zh: 物联网描绘了这样一个世界：从冰箱、恒温器到工业传感器和医疗植入物，数十亿日常物品接入网络并自主通信；它承诺带来前所未有的便利与效率，但同时也为企图攻击关键基础设施的恶意行为者扩大了可乘之机。

data.en: Beyond the well-known applications of CRISPR in agriculture and medicine, the technology has proven to be an extraordinarily versatile molecular tool, enabling researchers to activate or silence specific genes, to tag proteins with fluorescent markers, and even to record transcriptional history within cells, yet each new application requires careful calibration to avoid off-target effects that could introduce unintended mutations.
data.zh: 除了CRISPR在农业和医学中广为人知的应用之外，该技术已被证明是一种用途极为广泛的分子工具：研究人员可以用它激活或沉默特定基因、用荧光标记给蛋白质打上标签，甚至在细胞内记录转录历史；然而每一种新应用都需要精心校准，以避免可能引入意外突变的脱靶效应。

data.en: Dark matter, which is believed to constitute roughly 27 percent of the total mass-energy content of the universe yet interacts with ordinary matter almost exclusively through gravity, remains one of the most profound puzzles in modern physics, and the failure of decades of direct detection experiments to observe it has driven theorists toward increasingly exotic candidate particles.
data.zh: 暗物质被认为约占宇宙总质能含量的27%，却几乎只通过引力与普通物质相互作用，它至今仍是现代物理学最深奥的谜题之一；数十年来直接探测实验均未能观测到它，这促使理论家们转向越来越新奇的候选粒子。

data.en: Although fully autonomous vehicles promise to eliminate the roughly 94 percent of traffic accidents that are attributed to human error, their deployment has proven far more difficult than early optimists predicted, because self-driving systems must safely interpret an effectively infinite variety of road situations, including ambiguous hand signals, unpredictable pedestrians, and weather conditions that degrade sensor performance.
data.zh: 虽然全自动驾驶汽车有望消除约94%归因于人为失误的交通事故，但其实际部署远比早期乐观主义者预想的困难得多，因为自动驾驶系统必须安全地解读几乎无穷无尽的道路情形，包括含糊的手势信号、难以预测的行人以及会降低传感器性能的天气状况。

data.en: Synthetic biology, which applies engineering principles of standardization, modularity, and abstraction to living organisms, has enabled scientists to reprogram bacteria to produce pharmaceuticals, biofuels, and industrial chemicals, but the deliberate construction of novel biological systems also necessitates rigorous biosafety frameworks to prevent the accidental or malicious release of engineered organisms.
data.zh: 合成生物学将标准化、模块化和抽象化等工程原理应用于生物体，使科学家能够对细菌进行重编程，令其生产药物、生物燃料和工业化学品；但刻意构建新型生物系统也要求建立严格的生物安全框架，以防工程生物被意外或恶意释放。

data.en: The deployment of fifth-generation wireless networks, which offer dramatically higher data rates, lower latency, and the capacity to connect massive numbers of devices simultaneously, is widely regarded as a foundational infrastructure for emerging applications such as telemedicine, industrial automation, and autonomous transportation, even as concerns about spectrum allocation, energy consumption, and health effects continue to circulate in public discourse.
data.zh: 第五代无线网络的部署带来了显著更高的数据速率、更低的延迟以及同时连接海量设备的能力，被广泛视为远程医疗、工业自动化和自动驾驶等新兴应用的基础设施；与此同时，关于频谱分配、能源消耗和健康影响的担忧仍在公众话语中持续流传。

data.en: The dramatic decline in the cost of whole-genome sequencing, which has fallen from roughly one hundred million dollars for the first human genome to under a thousand dollars today, has made personal genomics widely accessible and has fueled a parallel growth in direct-to-consumer genetic testing services that raise important questions about informed consent, data ownership, and the interpretation of variants of uncertain significance.
data.zh: 全基因组测序成本急剧下降——从首个人类基因组约一亿美元降至如今不足一千美元——使个人基因组学变得触手可及，同时推动了直接面向消费者的基因检测服务同步增长，而这些服务引发了关于知情同意、数据所有权以及意义不明变异体如何解读等重大问题。

data.en: Additive manufacturing, more commonly known as three-dimensional printing, has evolved from a rapid-prototyping curiosity into a serious production technology capable of fabricating complex geometries—including lattice structures, patient-specific implants, and rocket engine components—that would be impossible or prohibitively expensive to produce through conventional subtractive machining.
data.zh: 增材制造（更常见的名称是三维打印）已从一种快速原型制作的新奇技术，发展成为能够制造复杂几何形状的严肃生产技术——包括点阵结构、患者定制植入物和火箭发动机部件——这些形状用传统减材加工根本无法制造，或成本高得令人却步。

data.en: Although silicon-based photovoltaic cells have dominated the solar energy market for decades, emerging thin-film and perovskite technologies promise higher efficiencies and lower manufacturing costs, but their commercial viability has been hampered by issues of stability, toxicity, and the difficulty of scaling laboratory breakthroughs to industrial production volumes.
data.zh: 虽然硅基光伏电池主导太阳能市场数十年，新兴的薄膜和钙钛矿技术有望实现更高效率和更低制造成本，但其商业可行性一直受到稳定性、毒性以及难以将实验室突破放大到工业生产规模等问题的制约。

data.en: The history of natural language processing can be understood as a progression from rule-based systems that required hand-crafted grammatical knowledge, through statistical models that learned from annotated corpora, to contemporary transformer-based architectures trained on vast amounts of unlabeled text, a trajectory that has produced dramatic improvements in machine translation, summarization, and question answering.
data.zh: 自然语言处理的历史可以理解为一条演进之路：从需要手工编写语法知识的基于规则的系统，到从标注语料中学习的统计模型，再到在海量无标注文本上训练的当代基于Transformer的架构；这一轨迹在机器翻译、摘要生成和问答领域带来了戏剧性的进步。

data.en: The detection of gravitational waves, ripples in the fabric of spacetime predicted by Einstein's general theory of relativity, by the Laser Interferometer Gravitational-Wave Observatory opened an entirely new window on the universe, allowing astronomers to observe catastrophic events such as black hole mergers and neutron star collisions that emit no light whatsoever.
data.zh: 激光干涉引力波天文台探测到引力波——爱因斯坦广义相对论预言的时空结构涟漪——为人类观测宇宙打开了一扇全新的窗口，使天文学家得以观测黑洞并合、中子星碰撞等完全不发出任何光线的灾难性事件。

data.en: Quantum key distribution exploits the counterintuitive properties of quantum entanglement to establish cryptographic keys whose security is guaranteed by the laws of physics rather than computational assumptions, yet the practical implementation of such systems over long distances remains constrained by photon loss in optical fibers, which currently limits secure quantum communication to a few hundred kilometers without trusted relays.
data.zh: 量子密钥分发利用量子纠缠的反直觉特性来建立密钥，其安全性由物理定律而非计算假设来保证；然而这类系统在远距离上的实际实现仍受制于光纤中的光子损耗，目前无信任中继的安全量子通信距离仅限于数百公里。

data.en: The human microbiome, which comprises trillions of microorganisms inhabiting the gut, skin, and other body surfaces, has been implicated in everything from digestion and immunity to mood regulation and even neurodegenerative disease, prompting researchers to reconsider the boundaries of what it means to be human and to explore therapeutic interventions ranging from fecal transplants to engineered probiotics.
data.zh: 人类微生物组由栖息于肠道、皮肤及其他体表的数万亿微生物组成，它被认为与从消化、免疫到情绪调节乃至神经退行性疾病等方方面面都有牵连，这促使研究人员重新思考“人”的边界，并探索从粪便移植到工程益生菌等一系列治疗干预手段。

data.en: Advocates of vertical farming argue that by stacking crops in climate-controlled indoor environments illuminated by LEDs, it is possible to grow fresh produce with a fraction of the water and land required by conventional agriculture, though skeptics point out that the substantial energy costs of lighting and climate control currently make the economics viable only for high-value crops such as leafy greens and herbs.
data.zh: 垂直农业的倡导者认为，通过在配备LED照明的气候受控室内环境中分层种植作物，可以用传统农业所需的一小部分水和土地生产新鲜农产品；然而怀疑者指出，照明和气候控制的巨额能源成本目前使这种模式仅在叶菜、香草等高价值作物的种植上具有经济可行性。

data.en: Neuromorphic computing, which seeks to emulate the architecture and energy efficiency of biological brains using specialized hardware such as spiking neural networks and memristive devices, represents a radical departure from the von Neumann paradigm, offering the tantalizing prospect of machine intelligence that approaches biological levels of efficiency, though the field remains in its infancy relative to conventional deep learning.
data.zh: 神经形态计算试图用脉冲神经网络、忆阻器件等专用硬件模拟生物大脑的架构与能效，是对冯·诺依曼范式的根本性背离，展现出接近生物水平效率的机器智能这一诱人前景；不过与常规深度学习相比，该领域仍处于起步阶段。

data.en: The reproducibility crisis, which refers to the alarming finding that a substantial fraction of published research findings in fields ranging from psychology to cancer biology cannot be replicated when the experiments are repeated, has prompted urgent reforms in scientific publishing, statistical practice, and laboratory culture, including pre-registration of studies, open data policies, and greater tolerance for null results.
data.zh: 可重复性危机指的是一个令人警醒的发现：从心理学到癌症生物学等各领域中，相当一部分已发表的研究成果在重复实验时无法复现；这一危机促使科学出版、统计实践和实验室文化进行紧急改革，包括研究预注册、开放数据政策以及对阴性结果的更大包容。

data.en: Notwithstanding the foregoing provisions, which set forth the respective rights and obligations of the parties in considerable detail, nothing contained in this Agreement shall be construed as creating a partnership, joint venture, or agency relationship between the parties, and neither party shall have the authority to bind the other in any manner whatsoever without the prior written consent of the other party, such consent to be obtained in accordance with the procedures prescribed in Section 8.2.
data.zh: 尽管前述条款已相当详尽地规定了双方各自的权利与义务，但本协议中的任何内容均不得被解释为在双方之间创设合伙、合资或代理关系；未经另一方事先书面同意（该同意应依照第8.2条规定之程序取得），任何一方均无权以任何方式约束另一方。

data.en: In interpreting the provisions of the Constitution, courts have consistently held that the enumerated rights must be read not in isolation but in conjunction with one another, and that the government bears the burden of demonstrating that any restriction on fundamental freedoms serves a compelling state interest and is narrowly tailored to achieve that interest through the least restrictive means available.
data.zh: 在解释宪法条文时，法院一贯主张：各项列举权利不得孤立解读，而必须相互结合理解；政府负有举证责任，须证明对基本自由的任何限制都服务于迫切的公共利益，并通过可用的限制性最小的手段精准地实现该利益。

data.en: The Due Process Clause of the Fourteenth Amendment, which prohibits the states from depriving any person of life, liberty, or property without due process of law, has been interpreted by the Supreme Court to encompass both procedural protections—such as notice, an opportunity to be heard, and an impartial tribunal—and substantive protections that shield certain fundamental rights from government interference regardless of the procedures employed.
data.zh: 第十四修正案的正当程序条款禁止各州未经正当法律程序剥夺任何人的生命、自由或财产；最高法院将其解释为既包含程序性保护——如通知、听证机会和中立裁判机构——也包含实质性保护，后者使某些基本权利免受政府干涉，无论采用何种程序。

data.en: Under the doctrine of state sovereignty, which constitutes a foundational principle of international law, every nation possesses the exclusive right to exercise jurisdiction over the persons, property, and events within its territorial boundaries, although this principle has been increasingly qualified by treaty obligations, customary international law, and the growing recognition of universal jurisdiction over such heinous crimes as genocide, crimes against humanity, and war crimes.
data.zh: 国家主权原则是国际法的一项基础性原则。依据该原则，每个国家对其领土范围内的人、财产和事件享有排他的管辖权；然而，条约义务、习惯国际法以及对种族灭绝、危害人类罪和战争罪等滔天罪行普遍管辖权的日益认可，正不断对这一原则加以限定。

data.en: In negligence actions, the plaintiff bears the burden of establishing by a preponderance of the evidence that the defendant owed a duty of care to the plaintiff, that the defendant breached that duty by failing to act as a reasonably prudent person would have acted under similar circumstances, that the breach was both the actual and proximate cause of the plaintiff's injuries, and that the plaintiff suffered actual damages as a result.
data.zh: 在过失侵权诉讼中，原告负有以优势证据证明下列事项的责任：被告对原告负有注意义务；被告未按理性谨慎人在类似情形下应有的行为方式行事，从而违反了该义务；该违反既是原告所受伤害的事实原因，也是近因；且原告因此遭受了实际损害。

data.en: The exclusionary rule, which provides that evidence obtained through violations of the Fourth Amendment's prohibition against unreasonable searches and seizures is inadmissible at trial, represents a judicially created remedy designed to deter police misconduct, but it has been the subject of persistent criticism on the ground that it allows guilty defendants to escape conviction because of technical errors unrelated to their guilt.
data.zh: 排除规则规定，通过违反第四修正案禁止不合理搜查扣押之规定取得的证据在审判中不可采；这是一项由司法创设、旨在震慑警察违法行为的救济措施，但它一直饱受批评，理由是它使有罪被告仅因与其罪行无关的技术性错误而逃脱定罪。

data.en: Patent protection, which grants inventors the exclusive right to exclude others from making, using, selling, or importing their claimed inventions for a limited term of twenty years from the filing date, seeks to strike a delicate balance between incentivizing innovation through the promise of temporary monopoly and ensuring that society ultimately benefits from the disclosure and eventual public availability of new technologies.
data.zh: 专利保护赋予发明人在自申请日起二十年的有限期限内排除他人制造、使用、销售或进口其主张之发明的专有权，其目的在于以临时垄断的承诺激励创新，同时确保社会最终从新技术的公开和最终公有化中获益，在二者之间求得微妙的平衡。

data.en: The hearsay rule, which generally excludes out-of-court statements offered for the truth of the matter asserted, rests on the premise that the declarant's credibility cannot be adequately tested through cross-examination when the statement is made outside the courtroom, although the rule is riddled with exceptions that admit such statements when they carry sufficient guarantees of trustworthiness, such as excited utterances, present sense impressions, and statements made for purposes of medical diagnosis or treatment.
data.zh: 传闻规则一般排除为证明所主张事实之真实性而提出的庭外陈述，其依据在于：陈述者在庭外作出陈述时，其可信度无法通过交叉询问得到充分检验；然而该规则充斥着例外，当陈述具有充分的可靠性保障——如激奋性陈述、当场感知印象以及为医疗诊断或治疗目的所作陈述——时即可采纳。

data.en: The business judgment rule, which shields corporate directors from personal liability for decisions made in good faith, with the care that a reasonably prudent person would exercise in a like position, and in the manner the director reasonably believes to be in the best interests of the corporation, reflects the principle that courts should not second-guess business decisions merely because they turn out poorly in hindsight.
data.zh: 商业判断规则使公司董事免于为其决策承担个人责任，只要该决策系善意作出、尽到了理性谨慎人在类似职位上应尽的注意，且以董事合理相信符合公司最佳利益的方式作出；该规则体现了如下原则：法院不应仅因商业决策事后看来结果不佳便加以事后诸葛式的否定。

data.en: The rule against perpetuities, an arcane common law doctrine that invalidates interests in property that might vest more than twenty-one years after the death of a life in being at the creation of the interest, has been described by generations of law students as a source of endless confusion, and its practical operation has been substantially modified or abolished in many jurisdictions through statutory reform.
data.zh: 禁止永久权规则是一项晦涩的普通法原则，它使可能在权益设立时尚在世的某人的死亡后二十一年之后才归属的财产权益归于无效；一代代法学院学生将其形容为无尽困惑之源，而许多司法辖区已通过立法改革对其实际运作作了大幅修改甚至废除。

data.en: Under the standard of review articulated in the Administrative Procedure Act, courts will set aside agency actions only if they are found to be arbitrary, capricious, an abuse of discretion, or otherwise not in accordance with law, a deferential standard that reflects Congress's judgment that administrative agencies possess specialized expertise that courts lack.
data.zh: 依据《行政程序法》所阐明的审查标准，法院仅在认定行政机关的行为武断、任性、滥用裁量权或与法律不符时才会予以撤销；这一谦抑的标准反映了国会的判断：行政机关拥有法院所不具备的专门专业知识。

data.en: When determining an appropriate sentence, courts are instructed to consider the nature and circumstances of the offense, the history and characteristics of the defendant, the need for the sentence to reflect the seriousness of the offense and to afford adequate deterrence to criminal conduct, and the need to protect the public from further crimes by the defendant, among other statutory factors.
data.zh: 在确定适当刑罚时，法院被要求考虑犯罪的性质与情节、被告人的经历与特征、刑罚须反映罪行严重性并足以对犯罪行为构成充分威慑的需要，以及保护公众免遭被告人再次犯罪的需要等法定因素。

data.en: The Universal Declaration of Human Rights, adopted by the United Nations General Assembly in 1948 in the aftermath of the Second World War, proclaims that all human beings are born free and equal in dignity and rights and enumerates a comprehensive catalogue of civil, political, economic, social, and cultural rights that, while not legally binding in itself, has come to be regarded as customary international law by many scholars.
data.zh: 第二次世界大战结束后的1948年，联合国大会通过了《世界人权宣言》。它宣告人人生而自由，在尊严和权利上一律平等，并列举了公民、政治、经济、社会和文化权利的完整清单；该宣言本身虽无法律拘束力，却已被许多学者视为习惯国际法。

data.en: The Sherman Antitrust Act, which prohibits contracts, combinations, and conspiracies in restraint of trade as well as monopolization and attempts to monopolize, has been interpreted by courts to condemn not only naked price-fixing agreements among competitors but also a broad range of exclusionary practices by dominant firms, provided that such practices produce anticompetitive effects in a properly defined relevant market.
data.zh: 《谢尔曼反托拉斯法》禁止限制贸易的合同、联合与共谋，也禁止垄断及企图垄断；法院将其解释为不仅谴责竞争者之间赤裸裸的固定价格协议，也谴责占支配地位企业的大范围排他性行为，前提是这些行为在恰当界定的相关市场中产生了反竞争效果。

data.en: In custody disputes, courts are guided by the best interests of the child standard, which requires a holistic assessment of factors including the emotional bonds between the child and each parent, the stability of each parent's home environment, the child's own wishes when of sufficient age and maturity, and the willingness of each parent to facilitate the child's relationship with the other parent.
data.zh: 在监护权纠纷中，法院以子女最大利益标准为指导，这要求对以下因素进行整体评估：子女与父母各自的感情纽带、父母各自家庭环境的稳定性、子女在达到一定年龄和成熟度时自身的意愿，以及父母各自是否愿意促进子女与另一方的关系。

data.en: Although the federal government enjoys broad authority over immigration policy under the plenary power doctrine, the courts have held that this authority is not entirely immune from constitutional constraints, and that immigration proceedings must nonetheless comply with fundamental requirements of due process, including the right to a fair hearing, the right to counsel at no expense to the government, and the right to seek review of adverse decisions.
data.zh: 尽管依据全权原则，联邦政府在移民政策上享有广泛的权力，但法院认为这种权力并非完全不受宪法约束，移民程序仍须遵守正当程序的基本要求，包括获得公正听证的权利、自费聘请律师的权利以及对不利决定寻求审查的权利。

data.en: The Clean Water Act, which prohibits the discharge of pollutants into navigable waters of the United States without a permit, has spawned decades of litigation over the precise meaning of the term 'waters of the United States,' with courts and regulators grappling over whether the statute reaches ephemeral streams, wetlands adjacent to tributaries, and groundwater hydrologically connected to surface waters.
data.zh: 《清洁水法》禁止未经许可向美国通航水域排放污染物；围绕“美国水域”一词的确切含义，数十年来诉讼不断，法院和监管机构一直纠结于该法是否涵盖季节性溪流、毗邻支流的湿地以及与地表水存在水文联系的地下水。

data.en: Under the principles of contract damages, the injured party is entitled to be placed in the position it would have occupied had the contract been fully performed, but recovery is limited to damages that were reasonably foreseeable at the time of contracting, that were caused by the breach, and that could not have been avoided by the injured party through reasonable efforts to mitigate.
data.zh: 依据合同损害赔偿原则，受损方有权被置于合同得到完全履行时其本应处于的地位；但可获赔偿的损失仅限于缔约时可以合理预见、由违约行为造成、且受损方无法通过合理的减损努力加以避免的损害。

data.en: The Fourth Amendment requires that search warrants be issued only upon a showing of probable cause, supported by oath or affirmation, and particularly describing the place to be searched and the persons or things to be seized, and evidence obtained through a search conducted in violation of these requirements may be suppressed at trial unless an exception to the warrant requirement applies.
data.zh: 第四修正案要求，搜查令只能在宣誓或郑重声明支持的基础上证明存在相当理由，并具体描述拟搜查的地点和拟扣押的人或物时方可签发；违反这些要求进行搜查所取得的证据，除非适用令状要求的例外情形，否则可在审判中被排除。

data.en: The principle of most-favored-nation treatment, which obligates each member of the World Trade Organization to extend to all other members the most favorable treatment it grants to any trading partner, constitutes the cornerstone of the nondiscrimination regime governing international trade, though it is subject to numerous exceptions permitting preferential arrangements among developing countries and regional trade agreements.
data.zh: 最惠国待遇原则要求世界贸易组织各成员将给予任何贸易伙伴的最优惠待遇扩展至所有其他成员，它构成了国际贸易非歧视体制的基石；不过该原则存在诸多例外，允许发展中国家之间以及区域贸易协定项下实行优惠安排。

data.en: Lawyers are bound by a duty of confidentiality that extends not only to information expressly communicated by clients in confidence but also to information relating to the representation that the lawyer reasonably believes would be embarrassing or detrimental to the client if disclosed, a duty that survives the termination of the attorney-client relationship and may be waived only by the client's informed consent.
data.zh: 律师负有保密义务，该义务不仅及于当事人以保密方式明确告知的信息，也及于律师合理相信一旦披露将使当事人难堪或受损的与代理有关的信息；该义务在律师与当事人关系终止后仍然存续，且只有经当事人知情同意方可放弃。

data.en: The automatic stay, which takes effect immediately upon the filing of a bankruptcy petition, operates to halt virtually all collection efforts by creditors—including lawsuits, foreclosures, garnishments, and repossessions—so that the debtor may obtain breathing room to reorganize or liquidate assets in an orderly fashion under the supervision of the bankruptcy court.
data.zh: 自动中止令自破产申请提交之时立即生效，它使债权人的几乎所有追偿行动——包括诉讼、取消抵押品赎回权、工资扣押和收回担保物——得以停止，从而使债务人获得喘息空间，在破产法院的监督下有序地重组或变卖资产。

data.en: Under the law of maritime salvage, a salvor who voluntarily renders assistance to a vessel in distress without an existing contractual obligation to do so is entitled to a reward calculated with reference to the value of the property saved, the degree of danger involved, the skill and promptness of the salvor, and the extent to which the salvage operations prevented environmental damage.
data.zh: 依据海难救助法，救助人在不存在既有合同义务的情况下自愿援助遇险船舶，有权获得报酬；报酬的数额参考获救财产的价值、所涉危险程度、救助人的技术与及时性，以及救助作业在多大程度上防止了环境损害等因素计算。

data.en: The canons of statutory interpretation, which furnish courts with a set of presumptions about legislative intent—including the plain meaning rule, the rule that specific provisions prevail over general ones, and the principle that statutes in derogation of the common law are to be strictly construed—are aids to reasoning rather than rigid commands, and their application often yields conflicting results that must be resolved by reference to the statute's purpose.
data.zh: 法律解释准则为法院提供了一套关于立法意图的推定——包括平义规则、特别规定优先于一般规定的规则，以及背离普通法的制定法应从严解释的原则——它们是推理的辅助工具而非僵硬的命令，其适用往往产生相互冲突的结果，须参照法律的目的加以解决。

data.en: The prohibition against torture, which is enshrined in numerous international instruments including the Convention against Torture and which has been recognized by courts and scholars alike as a norm of jus cogens from which no derogation is permitted, imposes obligations not only to refrain from the practice itself but also to investigate allegations, prosecute offenders, and provide redress to victims.
data.zh: 禁止酷刑的规定载于包括《禁止酷刑公约》在内的众多国际文书中，并被法院和学者共同认定为不容克减的强行法规范；它施加的义务不仅包括自身不得实施酷刑，还包括调查指控、起诉犯罪者以及为受害者提供救济。

data.en: The right to privacy, which Justice Brandeis famously described as 'the right to be let alone,' has evolved in American law into a multifaceted doctrine encompassing protection against unreasonable searches, the confidentiality of personal information, restrictions on commercial exploitation of one's name and likeness, and a limited right to informational self-determination that has taken on new urgency in the age of digital surveillance.
data.zh: 布兰代斯大法官曾将隐私权形象地称为“独处的权利”；在美国法中，这一权利已演变为一个多层面的原则，涵盖免受不合理搜查的保护、个人信息的保密、对他人姓名和肖像进行商业利用的限制，以及在数字监控时代具有全新紧迫性的有限的信息自决权。

data.en: The right to effective assistance of counsel, guaranteed by the Sixth Amendment, requires that defense attorneys conduct a reasonable investigation into the facts of the case, make informed strategic decisions based on that investigation, and subject the prosecution's case to meaningful adversarial testing, and a defendant who can demonstrate that counsel's performance fell below an objective standard of reasonableness and that prejudice resulted may be entitled to a new trial.
data.zh: 第六修正案保障的获得有效律师协助的权利，要求辩护律师对案件事实进行合理的调查、基于该调查作出知情的策略性决定，并对控方的指控进行有意义的对抗性检验；能够证明律师的表现低于客观合理性标准并因此遭受损害的被告，可能有权获得重新审判。

data.en: In international commercial arbitration, the principle of party autonomy allows the disputing parties to choose the governing law, the seat of arbitration, the procedural rules, and even the identity of the arbitrators, and the resulting award, which is final and binding and subject to only limited grounds for challenge, can be enforced in over 160 countries by virtue of the New York Convention.
data.zh: 在国际商事仲裁中，当事人意思自治原则允许争议双方选择准据法、仲裁地、程序规则乃至仲裁员的身份；由此作出的裁决具有终局性和拘束力，仅能以有限的理由提出异议，并凭借《纽约公约》可在160多个国家得到执行。

data.en: The doctrine of personal jurisdiction requires that a court's exercise of authority over a defendant comport with both the statutory requirements of the forum state's long-arm statute and the constitutional demands of due process, which mandates that the defendant have sufficient minimum contacts with the forum such that the maintenance of the suit does not offend traditional notions of fair play and substantial justice.
data.zh: 属人管辖原则要求法院对被告行使管辖权，既须符合法院地州长臂法规的成文法要求，也须满足正当程序的宪法要求；后者规定被告须与法院地存在充分的最低限度联系，以使诉讼的维持不违背公平竞争与实质正义的传统观念。

data.en: The doctrine of consideration, which requires that each party to a contract receive something of value in exchange for the promise that it makes, embodies the principle that gratuitous promises, however solemnly made, are not enforceable unless they have been relied upon to the promisee's detriment, a principle that distinguishes contractual obligations from mere moral duties.
data.zh: 对价原则要求合同一方必须因其所作出的承诺而获得某种具有价值的回报，它体现了如下原则：无偿的承诺无论作出时多么郑重，除非受诺人已基于信赖而遭受损害，否则不具有强制执行力；这一原则使合同义务有别于单纯的道德义务。

data.en: Clinical trials for a new pharmaceutical agent typically proceed through three sequential phases, beginning with small studies designed primarily to assess safety and tolerability in healthy volunteers, followed by larger trials that evaluate efficacy and optimal dosing in patients with the target condition, and culminating in extensive confirmatory studies that must demonstrate statistically significant benefit before regulatory authorities will consider granting marketing approval.
data.zh: 新药的临床试验通常依次经过三个阶段：首先进行小规模研究，主要评估健康志愿者中的安全性与耐受性；随后开展较大规模的试验，在患目标疾病的患者中评价疗效并确定最佳剂量；最后进行广泛的验证性研究，必须证明统计学上显著的获益，监管机构才会考虑批准上市。

data.en: The placebo effect, far from being a mere nuisance that must be controlled for in clinical research, represents a genuine neurobiological phenomenon in which expectations of improvement can trigger measurable changes in pain perception, immune function, and even the release of endogenous opioids, and understanding its mechanisms may eventually allow physicians to harness it deliberately in patient care.
data.zh: 安慰剂效应远非临床研究中只需加以控制的干扰因素，而是一种真实的神经生物学现象：对改善的期待可以引发疼痛感知、免疫功能乃至内源性阿片类物质释放的可测量变化；理解其机制或许终将使医生能够在患者照护中有意地加以利用。

data.en: Antibiotic resistance, which arises when bacterial populations evolve mechanisms to neutralize the drugs designed to kill them, has been described by public health authorities as one of the greatest threats to modern medicine, because routine procedures such as joint replacement, organ transplantation, and chemotherapy—all of which depend on effective infection control—would become perilous if first-line antibiotics ceased to work.
data.zh: 细菌群体进化出中和旨在杀灭它们的药物的机制时，抗生素耐药性便随之产生；公共卫生当局将其描述为现代医学面临的最大威胁之一，因为如果一线抗生素失效，关节置换、器官移植、化疗等依赖有效感染控制的常规操作都将变得危险重重。

data.en: Although vaccination has been credited with eradicating smallpox and nearly eliminating polio, the persistence of vaccine hesitancy, fueled by misinformation circulating on social media platforms, has allowed measles and other vaccine-preventable diseases to resurge in communities where immunization rates have fallen below the threshold required for herd immunity.
data.zh: 尽管疫苗接种被公认为消灭了天花并几乎根除了脊髓灰质炎，但在社交媒体平台上流传的虚假信息的推波助澜下，疫苗犹豫持续存在，导致麻疹等疫苗可预防疾病在免疫接种率低于群体免疫所需阈值的社区中卷土重来。

data.en: The human brain, which contains roughly 86 billion neurons connected by trillions of synapses, continues to astonish neuroscientists, because despite decades of research we still lack a comprehensive account of how the coordinated activity of these cells gives rise to consciousness, memory, and the sense of self.
data.zh: 人类大脑含有约860亿个神经元，由数万亿个突触相互连接；它至今仍令神经科学家惊叹，因为尽管研究已进行了数十年，我们依然无法完整地解释这些细胞的协同活动如何产生意识、记忆和自我感。

data.en: Precision medicine, which seeks to tailor prevention and treatment strategies to the individual characteristics of each patient—including their genetic makeup, biomarker profiles, lifestyle, and environment—promises to transform healthcare, but its realization depends on the accumulation of vast genomic and clinical datasets whose interpretation raises profound questions about privacy and equity.
data.zh: 精准医学力求根据每位患者的个体特征——包括基因构成、生物标志物谱、生活方式和环境——量身定制预防与治疗策略，它有望变革医疗保健；但其实现有赖于积累庞大的基因组与临床数据集，而对这些数据的解读引发了关于隐私和公平的深刻问题。

data.en: The gut microbiome, which encompasses the trillions of bacteria, viruses, and fungi that inhabit the human digestive tract, has been shown in recent years to influence not only digestion and nutrient absorption but also immune function, metabolic health, and even mood and behavior, through complex signaling pathways that connect the intestine to the brain.
data.zh: 肠道微生物组涵盖栖息于人类消化道中的数万亿细菌、病毒和真菌；近年来的研究表明，它通过连接肠道与大脑的复杂信号通路，不仅影响消化和营养吸收，还影响免疫功能、代谢健康乃至情绪和行为。

data.en: Cancer immunotherapy, which works by unleashing the patient's own immune system to recognize and destroy malignant cells rather than by poisoning them with cytotoxic drugs, has achieved remarkable successes in melanoma and certain lung cancers, yet most patients still do not respond to existing checkpoint inhibitors, and identifying reliable biomarkers of response remains an urgent research priority.
data.zh: 癌症免疫疗法不是用细胞毒性药物毒杀癌细胞，而是释放患者自身的免疫系统去识别和摧毁恶性细胞；它在黑色素瘤和某些肺癌中取得了显著成功，然而大多数患者对现有的检查点抑制剂仍无反应，寻找可靠的疗效反应生物标志物仍是紧迫的研究重点。

data.en: Sleep, which occupies roughly one-third of the human lifespan and whose precise functions remain incompletely understood, is now recognized as essential to memory consolidation, metabolic regulation, immune defense, and emotional stability, and chronic sleep deprivation has been linked to an elevated risk of cardiovascular disease, obesity, diabetes, and cognitive decline.
data.zh: 睡眠约占人类寿命的三分之一，其确切功能至今尚未完全阐明；如今它被公认为对记忆巩固、代谢调节、免疫防御和情绪稳定至关重要，而长期睡眠不足与心血管疾病、肥胖、糖尿病和认知能力下降风险的升高密切相关。

data.en: Organ transplantation, which offers the only life-saving treatment for many patients with end-stage organ failure, is constrained by a chronic shortage of donor organs, prompting intense research into alternatives such as xenotransplantation using genetically modified pigs and the bioengineering of replacement organs from patient-derived stem cells.
data.zh: 器官移植是许多终末期器官衰竭患者唯一的救命治疗手段，却长期受制于供体器官短缺；这促使研究人员大力探索替代方案，如使用基因修饰猪进行异种移植，以及利用患者自体干细胞生物工程培育替代器官。

data.en: The Framingham Heart Study, which has followed three generations of residents of a small Massachusetts town since 1948, fundamentally changed our understanding of cardiovascular disease by demonstrating that heart attacks are not an inevitable consequence of aging but are strongly influenced by modifiable risk factors such as smoking, high blood pressure, and elevated cholesterol.
data.zh: 自1948年以来，弗雷明汉心脏研究对马萨诸塞州一个小镇的三代居民进行了追踪随访；它证明心脏病发作并非衰老的必然结果，而在很大程度上受吸烟、高血压、胆固醇升高等可改变风险因素的影响，从而从根本上改变了我们对心血管疾病的认识。

data.en: Epidemiological modeling, which uses mathematical equations to simulate the transmission of infectious diseases through populations, proved indispensable during the COVID-19 pandemic for forecasting hospital demand and evaluating the impact of interventions, although the accuracy of such models depends critically on assumptions about contact patterns, asymptomatic transmission, and the duration of immunity.
data.zh: 流行病学建模利用数学方程模拟传染病在人群中的传播；在COVID-19疫情期间，它在预测医院需求和评估干预措施效果方面被证明不可或缺，尽管此类模型的准确性在很大程度上取决于对接触模式、无症状传播和免疫持续时间的假设。

data.en: Gene therapy, which aims to treat or cure inherited disorders by introducing functional copies of defective genes into patients' cells, has moved from the realm of experimental promise to clinical reality for conditions such as spinal muscular atrophy and certain inherited retinal diseases, but the high cost of these one-time treatments and uncertainty about their long-term durability raise difficult questions for healthcare systems.
data.zh: 基因疗法旨在通过将缺陷基因的功能性拷贝导入患者细胞来治疗或治愈遗传性疾病；对于脊髓性肌萎缩症和某些遗传性视网膜疾病，它已从实验性的美好愿景变为临床现实；然而这类一次性治疗费用高昂，长期持久性也存有不确定性，给医疗体系提出了难题。

data.en: Chronic stress, which activates the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis and floods the body with cortisol, exerts a pervasive influence on health, accelerating the aging of immune cells, impairing cardiovascular function, and contributing to the pathophysiology of depression, anxiety, and post-traumatic stress disorder.
data.zh: 慢性应激会激活下丘脑—垂体—肾上腺轴，使体内充满皮质醇，对健康产生广泛影响：它加速免疫细胞衰老，损害心血管功能，并参与抑郁症、焦虑症和创伤后应激障碍的病理生理过程。

data.en: The development of anesthetic agents in the nineteenth century, which made surgery painless for the first time in human history, ranks among the most important milestones in medicine, yet the mechanisms by which general anesthetics produce unconsciousness remain surprisingly poorly understood, and anesthesiologists still rely largely on empirical observation to calibrate dosing.
data.zh: 十九世纪麻醉剂的发明使外科手术在人类历史上第一次不再疼痛，堪称医学史上最重要的里程碑之一；然而全麻药物产生意识丧失的机制至今仍出人意料地缺乏了解，麻醉医师在很大程度上仍依靠经验观察来校准剂量。

data.en: Public health interventions such as clean water supply, sanitation, and vaccination have historically contributed far more to the dramatic increase in life expectancy observed over the past two centuries than curative medicine has, a fact that underscores the importance of population-level approaches to disease prevention even in an era of dazzling biomedical innovation.
data.zh: 从历史上看，清洁供水、环境卫生和疫苗接种等公共卫生干预措施对过去两个世纪人均寿命的大幅提高所做的贡献，远大于治疗性医学；这一事实凸显了即使在生物医学创新令人目眩的时代，以人群为对象的疾病预防方法依然至关重要。

data.en: Medical imaging technologies, from the discovery of X-rays in 1895 to the development of computed tomography, magnetic resonance imaging, and positron emission tomography, have revolutionized diagnosis by allowing physicians to visualize the interior of the living human body without surgery, although the rising use of imaging has also raised concerns about overdiagnosis and the detection of clinically insignificant incidental findings.
data.zh: 从1895年X射线的发现，到计算机断层扫描、磁共振成像和正电子发射断层扫描的发展，医学影像技术使医生无需手术即可观察活体人体内部，从而彻底改变了诊断方式；然而影像检查使用量的上升也引发了关于过度诊断和检出临床上无意义的偶然发现的担忧。

data.en: The placebo-controlled double-blind randomized trial, in which neither the patients nor the investigators know who is receiving the active treatment and who is receiving the inert comparator, is widely regarded as the gold standard for evaluating medical interventions, because it eliminates the biases introduced by expectations and by the natural course of disease.
data.zh: 在安慰剂对照双盲随机试验中，患者和研究者都不知道谁在接受活性治疗、谁在接受惰性对照；它被广泛视为评价医疗干预的金标准，因为它排除了期望因素和疾病自然进程所带来的偏倚。

data.en: Age-related cognitive decline, long considered an inevitable consequence of growing old, is now understood to be influenced by a complex interplay of genetic predisposition, cardiovascular health, lifelong intellectual engagement, social connectedness, and diet, and accumulating evidence suggests that certain modifiable factors may significantly delay the onset of dementia.
data.zh: 长期以来，与年龄相关的认知衰退被视为衰老的必然结果；如今人们认识到，它受到遗传易感性、心血管健康、终身智力参与、社会联系和饮食等因素复杂相互作用的影响，且越来越多的证据表明，某些可改变的因素可能显著延缓痴呆的发病。

data.en: Medical errors, which are estimated to cause tens of thousands of deaths in hospitals each year, are increasingly recognized not as failures of individual clinicians but as symptoms of systemic problems in healthcare delivery, prompting the adoption of checklists, electronic prescribing, and a culture of safety that encourages reporting without blame.
data.zh: 据估计，医疗差错每年在医院中造成数万人死亡；人们日益认识到，它们并非个别医务人员的失职，而是医疗服务体系性问题的症状，这促使业界采用核对清单、电子处方，并培育鼓励无责上报的安全文化。

data.en: The discovery of penicillin by Alexander Fleming in 1928, and its subsequent mass production during the Second World War, inaugurated the antibiotic era and transformed the treatment of bacterial infections from a desperate gamble into routine practice, though the subsequent emergence of resistance has taught the sobering lesson that antimicrobial drugs are a finite resource.
data.zh: 1928年亚历山大·弗莱明发现青霉素，随后在第二次世界大战期间实现大规模生产，由此开启了抗生素时代，将细菌感染的治疗从孤注一掷的赌博变为常规操作；然而此后耐药性的出现带来了发人深省的教训：抗菌药物是一种有限的资源。

data.en: Stem cell research, which holds the potential to regenerate damaged tissues and organs, has been the subject of intense ethical debate, particularly with respect to the use of embryonic stem cells, although the development of induced pluripotent stem cells, which are reprogrammed from adult cells, has offered an alternative approach that circumvents many of the moral objections.
data.zh: 干细胞研究具有再生受损组织和器官的潜力，一直处于激烈伦理争论的中心，尤其是在胚胎干细胞的使用方面；不过，由成体细胞重编程而来的诱导多能干细胞的发展，提供了一条绕开许多道德反对意见的替代途径。

data.en: The aging of the world's population, which is being driven by declining fertility rates and increasing life expectancy, presents healthcare systems with unprecedented challenges, because older adults typically suffer from multiple chronic conditions simultaneously and require coordinated care that spans primary care, specialist services, and long-term support.
data.zh: 在生育率下降和预期寿命延长的推动下，世界人口正在老龄化，这给医疗体系带来了前所未有的挑战：老年人通常同时患有多种慢性疾病，需要跨越初级保健、专科服务和长期照护的协调性医疗。

data.en: Nutritional science has progressively moved beyond the simple identification of vitamins and minerals to examine the complex interactions between diet, the gut microbiome, and metabolic regulation, and current dietary guidelines increasingly emphasize whole foods and dietary patterns rather than isolated nutrients.
data.zh: 营养科学已逐步超越简单识别维生素和矿物质的阶段，转而研究饮食、肠道微生物组与代谢调节之间的复杂相互作用；当前的膳食指南日益强调完整食物和膳食模式，而非孤立营养素。

data.en: Telemedicine, which experienced explosive growth during the COVID-19 pandemic as clinics closed their doors to non-urgent visits, has demonstrated that many aspects of healthcare can be delivered effectively at a distance, although questions remain about the quality of remote physical examinations, digital disparities among underserved populations, and the appropriate reimbursement models for virtual care.
data.zh: 在COVID-19疫情期间，由于诊所对非紧急就诊关闭大门，远程医疗经历了爆发式增长；它证明医疗保健的许多方面可以在远距离上有效提供，尽管远程体格检查的质量、服务不足人群中的数字鸿沟以及虚拟诊疗的适当报销模式等问题依然存在。

data.en: The hypothalamus, a small but crucial region of the brain that regulates hunger, thirst, body temperature, and the sleep-wake cycle, orchestrates a vast array of homeostatic processes through the release of hormones and neuropeptides, and disruptions in its function have been implicated in obesity, eating disorders, and chronic fatigue syndrome.
data.zh: 下丘脑是大脑中一个体积虽小却至关重要的区域，负责调节饥饿、口渴、体温和睡眠—觉醒周期；它通过释放激素和神经肽协调着大量稳态过程，其功能紊乱被认为与肥胖、进食障碍和慢性疲劳综合征有关。

data.en: Maternal mortality, which remains stubbornly high in many parts of the world despite decades of public health efforts, is regarded by researchers as a sentinel indicator of the quality of a healthcare system, because it reflects not only the availability of obstetric services but also the broader social determinants of health that shape women's wellbeing across their lifetimes.
data.zh: 尽管数十年的公共卫生努力未曾间断，世界许多地区的孕产妇死亡率仍然居高不下；研究人员将其视为医疗体系质量的前哨指标，因为它不仅反映产科服务的可及性，也反映影响女性一生福祉的更广泛健康社会决定因素。

data.en: The opioid epidemic, which has claimed hundreds of thousands of lives in the United States over the past two decades, illustrates the tragic consequences of well-intentioned but poorly managed approaches to pain management, as aggressive marketing of prescription opioids, inadequate addiction treatment infrastructure, and the subsequent flood of illicit fentanyl combined to create a public health catastrophe.
data.zh: 过去二十年间，阿片类药物流行已在夺去美国数十万人的生命；它昭示了出于善意却管理不善的疼痛处理方式的悲惨后果——处方阿片类药物的激进营销、成瘾治疗设施的不足，以及随后非法芬太尼的大量涌入，共同酿成了一场公共卫生灾难。

data.en: Artificial intelligence in radiology, which uses deep learning algorithms trained on millions of medical images to detect abnormalities with sensitivity that sometimes matches or exceeds that of human radiologists, promises to improve diagnostic accuracy and efficiency, but its integration into clinical practice raises questions about liability, explainability, and the erosion of clinical skills.
data.zh: 放射学中的人工智能使用在数百万医学图像上训练的深度学习算法来检测异常，其灵敏度有时达到甚至超过人类放射科医师的水平，有望提高诊断的准确性和效率；但将其融入临床实践引发了关于责任归属、可解释性以及临床技能退化的问题。

data.en: The lymphatic system, long dismissed as a passive drainage network of secondary importance, has emerged in recent decades as a critical player in immune surveillance, fat absorption, and the removal of metabolic waste from the brain, and the discovery of the glymphatic system has opened new avenues for understanding neurodegenerative diseases such as Alzheimer's.
data.zh: 淋巴系统长期以来被视为次要的被动引流网络，近几十年来却被发现是免疫监视、脂肪吸收以及清除大脑代谢废物的重要参与者；类淋巴系统的发现为理解阿尔茨海默病等神经退行性疾病开辟了新途径。

data.en: Monetary policy, which is conducted by central banks through instruments such as interest rate targeting, open market operations, and reserve requirements, exerts its influence on the real economy with long and variable lags, a feature that complicates the task of policymakers who must decide today what level of policy tightness will be appropriate for an economy whose condition can only be forecast, never known with certainty.
data.zh: 中央银行通过利率目标、公开市场操作和存款准备金率等工具实施货币政策，其作用于实体经济时存在漫长且不稳定的时滞；这一特性使决策者的任务变得复杂：他们必须在今天就决定何种程度的政策紧缩适合一个只能预测、无法确知的经济状况。

data.en: The Efficient Market Hypothesis, which holds that asset prices fully reflect all available information at any given moment, has profoundly shaped both academic finance and investment practice, yet its validity has been repeatedly challenged by documented anomalies such as momentum effects, calendar patterns, and the tendency of stock prices to overreact to dramatic news events.
data.zh: 有效市场假说认为资产价格在任何时刻都充分反映了所有可得信息，它深刻塑造了学术金融学和投资实践；然而，有据可查的动量效应、日历效应以及股价对重大新闻事件过度反应等现象一再对其有效性提出挑战。

data.en: Behavioral finance, which integrates insights from psychology into the study of financial markets, demonstrates that investors are subject to systematic biases—including overconfidence, loss aversion, herding behavior, and the disposition effect—that cause them to deviate from the rational calculus assumed by classical economic theory and to make decisions that are often suboptimal for their own long-term welfare.
data.zh: 行为金融学将心理学的洞见融入金融市场研究，证明投资者会受到包括过度自信、损失厌恶、从众行为和处置效应在内的系统性偏差的影响，这些偏差使他们偏离古典经济理论所假设的理性算计，常常作出不利于自身长期福祉的次优决策。

data.en: A derivative is a financial instrument whose value derives from the performance of an underlying asset, index, or benchmark, and although derivatives serve legitimate purposes such as hedging risk and enabling price discovery, the enormous notional values involved, together with the opacity of certain instruments such as collateralized debt obligations, contributed significantly to the global financial crisis of 2008.
data.zh: 衍生品是一种价值源自标的资产、指数或基准表现的金融工具；尽管衍生品服务于对冲风险和价格发现等正当目的，但其所涉及的巨额名义价值，加上债务抵押债券等某些工具的透明度不足，对2008年全球金融危机起了重要的推波助澜作用。

data.en: The Federal Reserve's dual mandate, which directs the central bank to pursue maximum employment and stable prices simultaneously, frequently confronts policymakers with uncomfortable trade-offs, because the instruments used to stimulate economic activity and reduce unemployment tend to increase inflationary pressures, while the measures required to restrain inflation risk pushing the economy into recession.
data.zh: 美联储的双重使命要求中央银行同时追求就业最大化和物价稳定，这常常使决策者面临两难取舍：用以刺激经济活动、降低失业率的工具往往会加大通胀压力，而遏制通胀所需的措施又有将经济推入衰退的风险。

data.en: Inflation, which erodes the purchasing power of money over time, redistributes wealth between borrowers and lenders, distorts price signals that guide resource allocation, and imposes a regressive burden on households that hold their savings in cash, is one of the most studied yet persistently debated phenomena in macroeconomics.
data.zh: 通货膨胀会随着时间侵蚀货币的购买力，在借贷双方之间重新分配财富，扭曲引导资源配置的价格信号，并对以现金持有储蓄的家庭施加累退性的负担；它是宏观经济学中研究最多却也争论不休的现象之一。

data.en: Compound interest, which Albert Einstein is apocryphally said to have called the eighth wonder of the world, works quietly but relentlessly in the background of every savings decision, and its power is such that small differences in the rate of return, compounded over decades, can produce astonishing differences in accumulated wealth.
data.zh: 据传阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦曾戏称复利是世界第八大奇迹；它在每一项储蓄决策的背后安静而执着地运转，其威力之大，以至于回报率的微小差异经过数十年的复利累积，可以产生令人瞠目的财富差距。

data.en: Corporate governance, which encompasses the systems, principles, and processes by which companies are directed and controlled, seeks to align the interests of managers with those of shareholders through mechanisms such as independent boards, executive compensation tied to long-term performance, and the discipline imposed by active markets for corporate control.
data.zh: 公司治理涵盖公司被指挥和控制的体系、原则与流程，它力图通过独立董事会、与长期业绩挂钩的高管薪酬以及活跃的公司控制权市场所施加的约束等机制，使管理层利益与股东利益保持一致。

data.en: Emerging market economies, which have accounted for an increasing share of global output and trade over the past three decades, remain vulnerable to sudden reversals of capital flows, currency crises, and the so-called middle-income trap, in which countries that have achieved rapid growth through low-cost manufacturing find it difficult to move up the value chain and sustain rising living standards.
data.zh: 过去三十年间，新兴市场经济体在全球产出和贸易中所占份额不断增加，但它们仍易受资本流动突然逆转、货币危机以及所谓中等收入陷阱的影响——陷入该陷阱的国家凭借低成本制造业实现了快速增长，却难以沿着价值链攀升并维持生活水平的持续提高。

data.en: The theory of comparative advantage, first articulated by David Ricardo in the early nineteenth century, demonstrates that countries benefit from specializing in the production of goods in which they have a relative cost advantage and trading for the rest, and this insight remains the intellectual foundation of the case for free trade despite persistent political challenges from those who bear the adjustment costs.
data.zh: 十九世纪初由大卫·李嘉图首次阐明的比较优势理论证明：各国专门生产自己具有相对成本优势的商品并用之交换其余商品，便能从中获益；尽管承受调整成本者不断在政治上提出挑战，这一洞见依然是自由贸易主张的思想基石。

data.en: Quantitative easing, an unconventional monetary policy tool in which a central bank purchases long-term government bonds and other securities to inject liquidity into the financial system, was deployed on an unprecedented scale following the 2008 crisis and again during the pandemic, but its long-run consequences for asset prices, income inequality, and financial stability remain subjects of vigorous debate.
data.zh: 量化宽松是一种非常规货币政策工具，中央银行通过购买长期政府债券和其他证券向金融体系注入流动性；2008年危机后以及疫情期间，各国以前所未有的规模实施了这一政策，但其对资产价格、收入不平等和金融稳定的长期影响仍是激烈争论的话题。

data.en: A stock market bubble occurs when the price of an asset, or a broad class of assets, rises far above its fundamental value, propelled by a narrative of perpetual growth, easy credit, and the fear of missing out, and history repeatedly demonstrates that bubbles eventually burst, destroying wealth and frequently dragging the real economy into recession.
data.zh: 当某项资产或某一大类资产的价格在永续增长叙事、宽松信贷和错失恐惧的推动下远高于其基本价值时，股市泡沫便告形成；历史一再证明，泡沫终将破裂，摧毁财富，并常常把实体经济拖入衰退。

data.en: The Basel Accords, which establish international standards for bank capital adequacy, stress testing, and liquidity requirements, were substantially strengthened in the aftermath of the 2008 crisis in the recognition that the failure of systemically important financial institutions can impose enormous costs on taxpayers and destabilize the entire global financial system.
data.zh: 巴塞尔协议确立了银行资本充足率、压力测试和流动性要求的国际标准；2008年危机之后，鉴于系统性重要金融机构的倒闭可能给纳税人带来巨额成本并动摇整个全球金融体系，这些标准得到了大幅强化。

data.en: Exchange rate movements, which are determined by the interaction of interest rate differentials, trade balances, capital flows, and market sentiment, exert powerful effects on the competitiveness of exporting industries, the real value of foreign currency denominated debt, and the domestic price level, and their volatility poses particular challenges for emerging economies that borrow in foreign currencies.
data.zh: 汇率变动由利率差异、贸易收支、资本流动和市场情绪的相互作用决定，对出口产业的竞争力、外币计价债务的实际价值和国内物价水平产生强大影响；其波动性对以外币借款的新兴经济体构成尤为严峻的挑战。

data.en: Financial literacy, which refers to the ability to understand and effectively use various financial skills including personal financial management, budgeting, and investing, is strongly correlated with retirement security, and the widespread deficiencies in financial knowledge documented across both developed and developing countries have prompted calls for systematic financial education beginning in school.
data.zh: 金融素养指理解并有效运用个人理财、预算编制和投资等各种金融技能的能力，它与退休保障密切相关；发达国家和发展中国家均记录到金融知识普遍不足的现象，这促使人们呼吁从学校开始开展系统性的金融教育。

data.en: The term structure of interest rates, which depicts the relationship between bond yields and their maturities, is closely watched by market participants and policymakers alike, because an inverted yield curve—in which short-term rates exceed long-term rates—has historically been a remarkably reliable leading indicator of impending economic recessions.
data.zh: 利率期限结构描绘债券收益率与其期限之间的关系，受到市场参与者和政策制定者的密切关注，因为收益率曲线倒挂（短期利率高于长期利率）在历史上一直是经济衰退即将来临的极为可靠的领先指标。

data.en: Shareholder activism, in which investors accumulate positions in underperforming companies and use their ownership stakes to demand changes in strategy, management, or capital allocation, has grown into a significant force in corporate finance, though critics argue that the short-term focus of many activist campaigns may come at the expense of long-term value creation.
data.zh: 股东积极主义指投资者增持表现不佳公司的股份，并利用其股权要求公司在战略、管理层或资本配置上作出改变；它已成长为公司金融中的一股重要力量，尽管批评者认为许多激进运动的短期主义取向可能以牺牲长期价值创造为代价。

data.en: The tragedy of the commons, which describes how individually rational actors can collectively deplete a shared resource, finds one of its clearest expressions in the phenomenon of speculative trading, where each participant rationally seeks to profit from rising prices while the aggregate behavior of the market drives valuations ever further from economic fundamentals.
data.zh: 公地悲剧描述的是个体理性行为者如何集体耗竭共享资源；它在投机交易现象中得到了最清晰的体现之一：每个参与者都理性地寻求从价格上涨中获利，而市场的集体行为却使估值日益偏离经济基本面。

data.en: Macroprudential regulation, which focuses on the stability of the financial system as a whole rather than the safety of individual institutions, employs tools such as countercyclical capital buffers, loan-to-value limits, and stress tests to dampen the credit cycles that have historically amplified economic booms and busts.
data.zh: 宏观审慎监管着眼于整个金融体系的稳定而非单个机构的安全，它运用逆周期资本缓冲、贷款价值比上限和压力测试等工具，抑制历史上放大了经济繁荣与萧条周期的信贷周期。

data.en: The concept of net present value, which discounts future cash flows to their present-day equivalent using an appropriate discount rate, provides the conceptual foundation for virtually all corporate investment decisions, because it allows managers to compare projects with different time horizons, risk profiles, and cash flow patterns on a common basis.
data.zh: 净现值概念以适当的折现率将未来现金流折现为其今日等价物，为几乎所有企业投资决策提供了概念基础，因为它使管理者能够在共同的基础上比较时间跨度、风险特征和现金流模式各不相同的项目。

data.en: Global supply chains, which have been built over decades on the logic of comparative advantage and just-in-time inventory management, proved remarkably fragile during the pandemic, when factory shutdowns, container shortages, and port congestion cascaded through the world economy, exposing the hidden costs of extreme efficiency and prompting a reassessment of resilience versus cost.
data.zh: 数十年来，全球供应链建立在比较优势逻辑和准时制库存管理之上；疫情期间，工厂停工、集装箱短缺和港口拥堵在世界经济中层层传导，供应链被证明极其脆弱，暴露出极端效率背后的隐性成本，促使人们重新权衡韧性与成本。

data.en: The Phillips curve, which describes an inverse relationship between unemployment and inflation, guided macroeconomic policy for decades until the stagflation of the 1970s discredited the simple version of the trade-off, and economists continue to debate the extent to which the relationship remains operative in an era of anchored inflation expectations and globalized labor markets.
data.zh: 菲利普斯曲线描述了失业与通胀之间的反向关系，数十年来一直指导着宏观经济政策，直至20世纪70年代的滞胀使这一简单取舍关系信誉扫地；在通胀预期被锚定、劳动力市场全球化的时代，这一关系在多大程度上仍然有效，经济学家至今争论不休。

data.en: Financial derivatives such as options and futures, when used judiciously, allow producers, consumers, and investors to transfer risk to those best able to bear it, yet the same instruments, when deployed with excessive leverage and insufficient understanding, can concentrate risk in ways that threaten the stability of the entire financial system, as the collapse of Long-Term Capital Management demonstrated.
data.zh: 期权、期货等金融衍生品在审慎使用时可让生产者、消费者和投资者将风险转移给最有能力承担者；然而同样的工具若以过度杠杆和缺乏了解的方式运用，便可能以威胁整个金融体系稳定的方式集中风险，长期资本管理公司的倒闭便证明了这一点。

data.en: The concept of moral hazard, which arises when one party takes risks because another party bears the consequences, is central to the economics of banking and insurance, and the implicit or explicit guarantees that governments provide to systemically important institutions create a fundamental tension between the stability benefits of protection and the incentives for excessive risk-taking that such protection engenders.
data.zh: 当一方因其行为后果由另一方承担而敢于冒险时，道德风险便随之产生；这一概念是银行与保险经济学的核心。政府对系统性重要机构提供的明示或默示担保，在保护带来的稳定收益与这种保护所催生的过度冒险激励之间，制造了一种根本性的张力。

data.en: Currency devaluation, whether undertaken deliberately as a policy tool or forced by market pressures, improves the price competitiveness of a country's exports but simultaneously raises the cost of imports, erodes the real value of domestic savings, and can trigger destabilizing capital flight if investors conclude that the exchange rate has further to fall.
data.zh: 货币贬值无论是作为政策工具有意为之，还是为市场压力所迫，都会提高一国出口的价格竞争力，但同时推高进口成本、侵蚀国内储蓄的实际价值；如果投资者认定汇率还将进一步下跌，还可能引发破坏稳定的资本外逃。

data.en: The Modigliani-Miller theorem, which demonstrates that under idealized conditions of perfect markets and no taxes the capital structure of a firm does not affect its value, is one of the most celebrated results in corporate finance, though its practical relevance derives precisely from the ways in which the real world deviates from its simplifying assumptions.
data.zh: 莫迪利亚尼—米勒定理证明，在无税收的完美市场的理想化条件下，企业的资本结构不影响其价值，它是公司金融学中最负盛名的成果之一；然而其现实意义恰恰源自真实世界偏离其简化假设的那些方面。

data.en: Index funds, which replicate the composition of broad market benchmarks at minimal cost, have grown from a curiosity into one of the dominant forces in global asset management, a development that has democratized access to diversified investing but has also raised concerns about the concentration of voting power in a small number of asset managers.
data.zh: 指数基金以极低的成本复制广泛市场基准的构成，已从一种新奇事物成长为全球资产管理中的主导力量之一；这一发展使多元化投资变得大众化，但也引发了关于投票权集中于少数资产管理机构的担忧。

data.en: Economic inequality, which has risen sharply in many advanced economies since the 1980s, is driven by a complex constellation of factors including technological change, globalization, the declining bargaining power of labor, and shifts in the tax and transfer systems, and its consequences for social cohesion, political stability, and long-run growth have become central concerns of economic research.
data.zh: 自20世纪80年代以来，许多发达经济体的经济不平等急剧上升；其背后是技术变革、全球化、劳动力议价能力下降以及税收与转移支付制度变迁等复杂因素的交织，它对社会凝聚力、政治稳定和长期增长的影响已成为经济学研究的核心关切。

data.en: Capital account liberalization, which removes restrictions on the cross-border movement of financial capital, can bring substantial benefits in the form of lower borrowing costs and more efficient allocation of investment, but the experiences of countries such as Thailand in 1997 demonstrate that abrupt reversals of capital flows can precipitate devastating currency and banking crises.
data.zh: 资本账户自由化取消了金融资本跨境流动的限制，能够以降低借贷成本和更有效配置投资的形式带来可观收益；但1997年泰国等国的经历表明，资本流动的突然逆转可能引发毁灭性的货币和银行危机。

data.en: Sustainable finance, which integrates environmental, social, and governance considerations into investment decisions, has moved from the margins to the mainstream of global capital markets, driven by investor demand, regulatory pressure, and the growing recognition that climate-related risks constitute material financial risks that traditional valuation models have systematically underpriced.
data.zh: 可持续金融将环境、社会和治理因素纳入投资决策；在投资者需求、监管压力以及日益增长的共识——气候相关风险构成传统估值模型系统性低估的重大财务风险——的推动下，它已从全球资本市场的边缘走向主流。

data.en: Memory, that strange and unreliable alchemist, does not preserve the past as it truly was but distills it through the alembic of longing, so that the rain that fell on a certain October afternoon forty years ago still smells of wet leaves and wood smoke whenever I close my eyes, while the faces of those who once shared my narrow room have long since faded into the gray indistinction of forgotten photographs.
data.zh: 记忆，这位奇异而不可靠的炼金术士，并不保存真实如初的过去，而是将之在渴望的蒸馏器中提纯：四十年前那个十月午后落下的雨，至今每当我闭上双眼，依然弥漫着湿树叶与木柴烟的气息，而曾经与我同住陋室的那些面孔，早已淡入被遗忘照片的灰色模糊之中。

data.en: Autumn rain, which begins as a fine drizzle barely visible against the gray sky and then swells into a steady drumming on the rooftops that continues through the night, has a way of slowing time itself, turning the familiar streets of the town into blurred watercolors and inviting even the busiest of minds to sit by the window and contemplate the transience of all things.
data.zh: 秋雨起初只是灰暗天幕下几乎看不见的细密雨丝，继而涨成屋顶上彻夜不息、节奏沉稳的鼓点；它自有让时间本身慢下来的魔力，把小镇熟悉的街道洇成朦胧的水彩画，连最忙碌的心灵也不由得坐到窗前，默想万物的易逝。

data.en: The old house on the hill, whose roof has sagged under the weight of a hundred winters and whose wooden beams groan like tired bones whenever the wind rises, still holds within its peeling walls the accumulated silence of generations, and to walk through its dim rooms is to feel the presence of all those who once laughed and quarreled and wept beneath these rafters.
data.zh: 山丘上的老屋，屋脊已被一百个冬天的重量压弯，每当风起，木梁便像疲惫的骨头般呻吟；在它剥落的墙壁之内，依然积聚着几代人的沉默，穿行于幽暗的屋宇之间，便能感到那些曾在椽下欢笑、争吵、哭泣的人们依旧在此。

data.en: The sea, which has no memory of the ships it has swallowed or the sailors it has claimed, continues to hurl itself against the same cliffs with the same patient fury it has displayed since before human beings first learned to walk upright, and there is something at once humbling and liberating in the thought that our griefs and triumphs are no more to it than the spume of a single wave.
data.zh: 大海不记得它吞没的船只，也不记得它夺走的船员，却依旧以人类学会直立行走之前就已展现的那份耐心的狂怒，日复一日地扑向同一片峭壁；想到我们的悲欢对它而言不过是一朵浪花的泡沫，这念头既令人谦卑，又令人释然。

data.en: There are books that entertain us, books that instruct us, and books that change us, and it is only the last kind—the kind that finds us at precisely the moment we are ready to receive it, that speaks to a hunger we did not know we had until the words appeared on the page—that deserves to be called an event in a life, rather than an episode in a pastime.
data.zh: 有些书让我们消遣，有些书教导我们，还有些书改变我们；唯有最后一种——恰在我们准备好接纳它的那一刻找到我们、诉说着一种直到文字跃然纸上我们才知晓的饥渴的书——才配被称为生命中的一件大事，而非消遣中的一个插曲。

data.en: Time, which we imagine as a river flowing inexorably from past to future, is experienced by memory as a series of islands scattered across an uncharted sea, some of them luminous with joy, others sinking beneath the weight of regret, and it is our strange fortune that the luminous ones grow brighter as we age while the dark ones recede into the mist.
data.zh: 我们把时间想象成一条从过去流向未来的不可逆转的河流，而记忆却将之体验为散落在无标航海图上的群岛：有的岛屿因欢乐而熠熠生辉，有的在悔恨的重压下沉没；我们的奇特际遇在于，随着年岁渐长，明亮的岛屿愈发耀眼，晦暗的岛屿则退入迷雾。

data.en: To love is to hand another person the keys to every room of your heart and to trust that they will not only resist the temptation to enter the locked chambers but will also, when you lose your own way in the corridors, find you and lead you gently back into the light.
data.zh: 爱，就是把心之每一间房门的钥匙都交给另一个人，并相信他们不仅会忍住不去推开上锁的房间，而且当你在走廊里迷失方向时，还会找到你，温柔地把你领回光明之中。

data.en: Loss, which arrives in life as surely as winter follows autumn, teaches us the terrible arithmetic of absence—the empty chair at the table, the unanswered telephone, the book left open on the page its owner will never turn—and yet it is precisely through such lessons that we learn the true weight of what we once possessed.
data.zh: 失落像冬天紧随秋天一样如期降临人生，它教会我们“缺席”的可怕算术：桌边空着的椅子、无人接听的电话、摊开在主人再也不会翻动的那一页上的书；然而，正是通过这些教训，我们才真正掂量出曾经拥有之物的分量。

data.en: Childhood, which we spend in a fever of impatience to escape and then mourn for the rest of our lives, is preserved less in the events themselves than in the quality of their light—the particular gold of a summer afternoon, the exact blue of a winter dusk—as if the world were once sharper, closer, more intensely itself than it can ever be again.
data.zh: 童年，我们在急于逃离的焦灼中度过，而后用余生去怀念；它被保存下来的与其说是那些事件本身，不如说是事件中光的质地——夏日午后特有的金黄、冬日晚霞精确的湛蓝——仿佛世界曾经比此后任何时刻都更清晰、更切近、更强烈地是它自己。

data.en: The city at dawn, when the streetlights are still burning against a sky that is neither night nor day and the first buses begin their laborious circuits through streets that belong, for a few precious hours, to the bakers, the cleaners, and the sleepless, reveals a secret life that the daytime city, with all its noise and hurry, manages to conceal from those who only know it in the light.
data.zh: 黎明时分的城市，街灯仍在既非夜亦非昼的天色下亮着，头班公交车开始吃力地巡行于街道之间——这些街道在珍贵的几小时里属于面包师、清洁工和失眠者；这座城市显露出隐秘的生活，而白昼的城市以它的喧嚣与匆忙，向那些只在日光下认识它的人成功地隐瞒了这一切。

data.en: To travel is to discover that the world is both smaller and larger than we imagined—smaller because the same fears and hopes greet us in every language, larger because every horizon we cross reveals another beyond it, until the very notion of arrival begins to seem less a destination than an illusion we carry with us.
data.zh: 旅行让人发现，世界比我们想象的既更小又更大：说它更小，是因为同样的恐惧与希望以各种语言迎接我们；说它更大，是因为我们每越过一道地平线，便又见到另一道地平线，直到“抵达”这个概念本身不再像一个目的地，而更像我们随身携带的一个幻觉。

data.en: Loneliness, which is not the same as solitude, is the feeling of being unseen even in a crowd, of speaking words that fall into silence, of reaching out a hand that no one takes, and those who have known it understand that it is not cured by company but only by the slow, uncertain work of being truly known by another.
data.zh: 孤独与独处不同：孤独是身在人群之中仍不被看见，是说出的话语坠入寂静，是伸出的手无人来握；经历过孤独的人都明白，它不会因有人陪伴而痊愈，只有通过被另一个人真正认识这缓慢而不确定的过程，才能得到医治。

data.en: Letters, which once carried the weight of absence across continents and oceans, have been reduced by the instant message to a mere curio, and yet there remains something irreplaceable in the physical trace of a beloved hand—the slight hesitation before a difficult sentence, the pressure of the pen on words written late at night—that no screen can ever reproduce.
data.zh: 书信曾把离别的重量驮过大陆与海洋，如今却被即时讯息贬为一件稀罕玩物；然而，爱人的笔迹留下的物理痕迹中，仍有一种任何屏幕都无法复制的不可替代之物——写到一个艰难句子前的微微踌躇，深夜书写时笔尖在字句上留下的力道。

data.en: The old tree at the edge of the meadow, which has weathered more storms than anyone can count and whose roots grip the earth with the tenacity of a creature that has decided never to let go, stands as a living testament to the virtue of stillness, teaching anyone who pauses beneath its canopy that endurance is itself a form of eloquence.
data.zh: 草地边缘的老树，历经的风暴多得无人能够数清，它的根须以某种决心永不放手的生物才有的坚韧抓住大地；它是一份关于“静立”之德的活着的证词，教每一个在它华盖下驻足的人懂得：忍耐本身就是一种雄辩。

data.en: Snow, which falls with a silence so complete that it seems to muffle the very machinery of the world, transforms the familiar landscape into something strange and new, and the first footprints pressed into its unblemished surface carry a significance that no mark made on ordinary ground can possess.
data.zh: 雪降落时带着一种彻底到仿佛给整个世界的机杼都罩上静音的寂静，把熟悉的风景变成陌生而崭新的东西；印在其无瑕表面上的第一行脚印，具有任何留在寻常土地上的痕迹都无法拥有的意义。

data.en: The river, which begins as a trickle in the mountains and gathers force and breadth as it travels toward the sea, does not ask where it is going or whether its journey has meaning, and perhaps this is why we find in its patient movement a comfort that the restless arithmetic of our own ambitions can never provide.
data.zh: 河流自山间的一线细流发端，在奔向大海的途中积蓄力量、拓宽身躯；它不追问自己要去哪里，也不追问自己的旅程是否有意义——也许正因为如此，我们才能在那耐心的流动中找到一种安慰，那是我们自己野心的焦躁算计永远无法给予的。

data.en: Music, which has no need of translation and speaks directly to that part of us that existed before language, can in the space of a few bars carry us back to the precise moment of a first dance, a farewell at a train station, or a funeral in the rain, and in doing so reminds us that feeling, unlike memory, never grows old.
data.zh: 音乐无需翻译，它直接对语言诞生之前就已存在于我们体内的那一部分说话；短短几个小节，它就能把我们带回初次共舞、车站告别或雨中葬礼的精确时刻，并以此提醒我们：感受与记忆不同，它永远不会衰老。

data.en: Farewells, which we rehearse a thousand times in our imagination and still cannot perform without stumbling, remind us that the heart is a poor student of goodbyes, for no matter how often we have been taught that all meetings end, we are always surprised to discover that this particular parting, which we thought would be like all the others, has somehow managed to wound us afresh.
data.zh: 离别，我们在想象中排练过千百次，临到上演时却依然磕磕绊绊；它提醒我们，心是告别这门功课的差生——无论我们多么经常被告知一切相聚终有尽时，我们总还是会惊讶地发现：这次我们以为会与以往毫无二致的分别，竟又设法在我们心上添了一道新伤。

data.en: The reunion of old friends after many years is a delicate ceremony in which each party must negotiate between the person the other has become and the person the other remembers, and the joy of these encounters lies less in the confirmation of what has remained the same than in the generous acceptance of what has changed.
data.zh: 多年后老友重逢是一场微妙的仪式：每一方都必须在对方如今所是的那个人与对方记忆中的那个人之间进行协商；这类相逢的喜悦，与其说在于确认了什么未曾改变，不如说在于慷慨地接纳了什么已经改变。

data.en: A lamp burning in a window at night is one of the oldest symbols of hope that human beings have devised, for it says that someone is awake, that someone is waiting, that the dark is not absolute, and the sight of such a light from a cold road has saved more travelers, in ways both literal and metaphorical, than any map or compass.
data.zh: 夜里窗内亮着的一盏灯，是人类设计出的最古老的希望象征之一：它表明有人醒着，有人在等待，黑暗并非绝对；在寒冷的路途上望见这样一点灯火，曾拯救过无数旅人——无论在字面意义上还是隐喻意义上——远多于任何地图或罗盘。

data.en: Moonlight, which transforms the ordinary world into a landscape of silver and shadow, has inspired more poetry than any other natural phenomenon, perhaps because it offers us the rare experience of seeing our familiar surroundings without quite recognizing them—a reminder that the world we think we know is only one version of itself.
data.zh: 月光把寻常世界变成银与影的风景，它所启发的诗歌超过任何其他自然现象；或许因为它给我们一种罕见的体验：看着熟悉的四周却几乎认不出它们——提醒我们，我们自以为认识的世界，不过是它众多面目中的一种。

data.en: Old photographs, which preserve not the past itself but a particular gaze upon the past, are melancholy objects, for the faces they show us are forever frozen at a moment that the people in them could not have known was precious, and the smiles they record are smiles that were given without the awareness that they would be asked to smile forever.
data.zh: 旧照片保存的并非过去本身，而是投向过去的一种特定目光；它们是令人怅惘之物，因为照片中的面孔永远冻结在当事人不可能知晓其珍贵的那一刻，它们记录下的微笑，是在并不知道自己将被要求永远微笑下去的情况下绽放的。

data.en: The wind, which is invisible and yet makes its presence known in every moving leaf and rattling window, is perhaps the closest thing the physical world has to a soul—always in motion, never seen, heard only in its effects—and there is a peculiar comfort in knowing that something so powerful can pass through a room without leaving a single trace.
data.zh: 风，看不见摸不着，却在每一片摇曳的叶子和每一扇吱呀作响的窗户中显露自身；它或许是有形世界中最接近灵魂的东西——永不停歇，从不现身，只在其后果中被听见——而知道如此强大的事物可以穿过一间屋子而不留一丝痕迹，其中自有一种奇特的慰藉。

data.en: Twilight, that ambiguous hour when the world hesitates between day and night, has a particular poignancy for those who are old enough to know that every light is followed by darkness, and the purple and gold of the western sky seems to speak a language of farewell that is both sad and strangely consoling.
data.zh: 黄昏，这个白天与黑夜之间犹疑的暧昧时辰，对年纪足以明白“每一道光亮之后必有黑暗”的人而言，别有一种酸楚；西天紫与金交织的颜色，仿佛在说着一种道别的语言，既悲伤，又莫名地宽慰人心。

data.en: Spring, which arrives each year with the same promises it has broken so many times before—the promise of renewal, of warmth, of a future that will be different from the past—has the remarkable capacity to make us believe again, and perhaps this is the deepest lesson of the seasons: that hope is not a rational calculation but a habit of the heart.
data.zh: 春天每年带着它此前已食言过无数次的相同承诺到来——更新的承诺、温暖的承诺、一个与过去不同的未来的承诺——却拥有令我们再次相信的非凡能力；或许这正是四季最深沉的教诲：希望不是理性的算计，而是心灵的习惯。

data.en: The harbor, where ships from distant ports unload their cargoes of tea and timber and memory, is a place where the world's distances are gathered into a single point, and to stand at the end of a pier at dusk, watching the lights of the fishing boats go out one by one, is to feel the vastness of the earth and the smallness of any single journey upon it.
data.zh: 港口，远方港口的船只在此卸下茶叶、木材与记忆的货物，它是世界的距离汇聚于一点的地方；黄昏时分站在码头尽头，望着渔船灯火一盏盏熄灭，便不由得感到大地的浩瀚，以及大地上任何一次单独旅程的渺小。

data.en: The stars, which are the same stars that shone upon the shepherds of ancient Palestine and the astronomers of the Song dynasty, remind us of the continuity of human wonder across all the centuries that separate us from those who looked up before us, and the constellations we still name are a kind of conversation conducted across the millennia.
data.zh: 这些星星，正是曾经照耀古代巴勒斯坦牧羊人与宋代天文学家的同一批星星；它们提醒我们，在分隔我们与那些先我们仰望者的所有世纪之间，人类的惊奇一脉相承；我们至今仍在命名的星座，便是一场跨越千年的对话。

data.en: The dead, who are supposed to stay buried, return to us in unexpected ways—in the smell of pipe tobacco on a winter street, in a phrase we hear spoken by a stranger, in a melody that begins to play on a radio in a cafe—and each such return, however brief, is both a gift and a wound.
data.zh: 逝者本该安眠于地下，却总在意想不到的地方回到我们身边——冬日街头一缕烟斗烟草的气息、陌生人嘴里听到的一句话、咖啡馆收音机里忽然响起的一段旋律——而每一次这样的归来，无论多么短暂，都既是馈赠，也是伤口。

data.en: Dreams, which occupy a third of our lives and yet obey no logic that we can apply to our waking hours, may be the mind's way of rehearsing the selves we might have been, and the people who appear in them, free of the constraints of time and propriety, sometimes speak to us with a frankness that they could never manage in the daylight world.
data.zh: 梦境占据我们生命的三分之一，却不遵守任何可用于清醒时辰的逻辑；它或许是心灵在排演我们本可以成为的那些自我——梦中出现的人摆脱了时间与礼数的束缚，有时会以一种他们在日光世界里永远无法做到的坦诚对我们说话。

data.en: A study filled with books is not merely a room but a portrait of its owner's mind, for the volumes we keep, the passages we underline, the margins we annotate, and the spines we have worn thin by repeated handling are all traces of the conversations we have conducted with authors across the centuries, and to sit among them is to be in the company of every thought we have ever had.
data.zh: 一间塞满书的书房不仅仅是一个房间，更是主人心灵的肖像：我们收藏的书卷、划线的段落、页边写下的批注、因反复摩挲而磨薄的书脊，全都是我们与历代作者交谈留下的痕迹；坐拥其间，便是与我们拥有过的每一个念头相伴。

data.en: The problem of free will, which asks whether human beings are truly the authors of their own actions or merely the vehicles through which prior causes unfold, has resisted resolution for more than two thousand years, and the discovery that our decisions are preceded by unconscious neural activity has only sharpened the question of where, if anywhere, freedom can be located in a universe governed by cause and effect.
data.zh: 自由意志问题追问：人类究竟是自己行为的真正作者，还是先前原因借以展开的单纯载体？两千多年来它始终未被解决；而“我们的决定之前存在着无意识的神经活动”这一发现，只是使以下问题变得更加尖锐：在一个受因果律支配的宇宙中，自由究竟存在于何处（如果它确实存在的话）。

data.en: Moral responsibility, which presupposes that agents could have acted otherwise and that praise and blame are therefore more than mere instruments of social control, appears to be undermined by a deterministic picture of the universe, yet most people continue to hold others accountable for their actions, suggesting that the intuition of responsibility is more resilient than the arguments against it.
data.zh: 道德责任以行动者本可以另有选择为前提，因此褒贬奖惩便不仅仅是社会控制的工具；一幅决定论的宇宙图景似乎足以瓦解这一前提，然而大多数人依旧要求他人为自己的行为负责，这说明责任的直觉比反对它的论证更具韧性。

data.en: Knowledge, traditionally defined as justified true belief, was shown by Edmund Gettier in 1963 to be a definition that can be satisfied by beliefs that are true and justified only by accident, and the ensuing half-century of epistemological debate, which has produced everything from reliabilism to virtue epistemology, has yet to yield a definition that all parties accept.
data.zh: 知识传统上被定义为“有证成的真信念”；1963年，埃德蒙·盖梯尔证明：某些信念只是偶然为真、偶然获得证成，却也能满足这一定义。此后半个世纪的认识论争论，从可靠主义到德性认识论成果纷呈，却始终未能得出一个各方都接受的定义。

data.en: Skepticism, which asks how we can be certain of anything when the senses can deceive us and the mind can be mistaken, is not a position that can be refuted by argument alone, for any argument presupposes the very reliability of reason that skepticism calls into question, and it is perhaps for this reason that the skeptic's challenge, though impossible to answer definitively, remains one of the most fruitful provocations in the history of philosophy.
data.zh: 怀疑论追问：既然感官会欺骗我们、心智会犯错，我们又如何能对任何事情确信不疑？这一立场无法单凭论证驳倒，因为任何论证都以理性本身的可靠性为前提，而怀疑论质疑的正是这种可靠性；或许正因如此，怀疑论的挑战虽然无法被一劳永逸地回应，却始终是哲学史上最富有成果的刺激之一。

data.en: Utilitarianism, which holds that actions are right in proportion as they tend to promote happiness and wrong as they tend to produce the reverse, has the great virtue of grounding morality in something measurable and shared, yet its demand that we maximize aggregate welfare can conflict with our deepest intuitions about individual rights, as the familiar example of sacrificing one person to save five demonstrates.
data.zh: 功利主义主张：行为之正当与增进幸福的程度成正比，之错误与产生相反结果的程度成正比；它的伟大优点在于把道德建立于某种可度量且人人共享的基础之上。然而它要求我们最大化总体福利，这却可能与我们对个体权利最深的直觉相冲突，牺牲一人以救五人的著名例子正说明了这一点。
