data.zh: 现代人权运动可追溯到1948年《世界人权宣言》；人权已成为政治诉求的普遍语言，其程度是此前任何道德语汇都未曾达到的；然而，权利宣告与权利落实之间的鸿沟依然巨大，而赋予人权道德力量的正是其普遍性，这份普遍性也使它们招致指责：人权是西方霸权的工具，而非真正共同人性的表达。

data.en: Freedom of expression, which John Stuart Mill defended on the grounds that silenced opinions may be true, that error has value when it is exposed by the collision of opinions, and that truth held without challenge degenerates into prejudice, remains the most contested of democratic rights, because its exercise can both sustain democracy and undermine it, and the regulation of speech in the age of algorithmic amplification has reopened questions that liberals thought settled.
data.zh: 约翰·斯图尔特·密尔为言论自由辩护的理由是：被压制的意见可能是真理；错误在意见碰撞中被揭穿时自有其价值；未经挑战而持有的真理会退化为偏见。言论自由至今仍是最具争议的民主权利，因为行使它既能维系民主，也能瓦解民主；在算法放大的时代，言论监管重新打开了自由派以为已经解决的问题。

data.en: Electoral systems, which translate votes into seats through mechanisms ranging from first-past-the-post to proportional representation, are not neutral technical devices but the most consequential rules in a democracy, because they determine which parties are viable, how coalitions are formed, and whether governments reflect the will of the majority or the arithmetic of the system, and the choice among them has profound consequences for the quality of representation.
data.zh: 选举制度通过从简单多数制到比例代表制等各种机制把选票转化为席位；它并非中立的技术装置，而是民主中最具决定性影响的规则：它决定哪些政党能够存活、联盟如何组成，以及政府反映的是多数人的意愿还是制度的算术；在它们之间的选择，对代表性的质量有着深远影响。

data.en: Social governance, which refers to the ways in which societies regulate their own affairs through a combination of state action, market mechanisms, and the norms and institutions of civil society, has become more complex as societies have become more diverse, and the challenge of balancing order with freedom, efficiency with equity, and expertise with participation has no once-and-for-all solution, only a series of provisional settlements.
data.zh: 社会治理指社会通过国家行动、市场机制以及公民社会的规范与制度的组合来管理自身事务的方式；随着社会日益多元，社会治理变得更加复杂；在秩序与自由、效率与公平、专业与参与之间求得平衡的挑战没有一劳永逸的解决方案，只有一连串临时性的安排。

data.en: Aging societies, which face the challenge of supporting growing numbers of retirees with shrinking workforces, confront not only fiscal problems—the sustainability of pension and health systems—but also questions of intergenerational justice, the redesign of work and retirement, and the adequacy of care for the elderly, and the responses of different societies to these challenges will shape their politics for decades to come.
data.zh: 老龄化社会面临以日益萎缩的劳动力供养不断增多的退休人口的挑战；它们不仅要应对财政问题——养老金与医疗体系的可持续性——还要面对代际正义、工作与退休制度的重新设计以及老年人照护是否充分等问题；不同社会对这些挑战的回应，将塑造它们未来数十年的政治。

data.en: Culture wars, which pit traditional against progressive values in struggles over family, religion, education, and national identity, have displaced class-based conflicts as the central axis of political division in many democracies, and the intensity of these conflicts is fed by media dynamics, demographic change, and the growing educational divide, which has aligned the highly educated with progressive positions and the less educated with traditional ones.
data.zh: 文化战争在家庭、宗教、教育和国家认同问题上让传统价值观与进步价值观正面交锋；在许多民主国家，它已取代阶级冲突成为政治分裂的中轴；媒体动态、人口变化以及日益扩大的教育鸿沟——它使高学历者与进步立场结盟、低学历者与保守立场结盟——为这些冲突的激烈程度火上浇油。

data.en: Digital surveillance, which has expanded dramatically as governments and corporations exploit the data trails that citizens generate in the course of daily life, poses a fundamental challenge to the liberal tradition, because the capacity to observe everyone all the time transforms the relationship between state and citizen even when no overt coercion occurs, and the trade-off between security, convenience, and privacy has become one of the defining political questions of the digital age.
data.zh: 随着政府与企业利用公民日常生活中的数据痕迹，数字监控急剧扩张；它对自由主义传统构成了根本性挑战，因为随时随地观察每一个人的能力，即使在没有公开强制的情况下也会改变国家与公民的关系；安全、便利与隐私之间的权衡，已成为数字时代最具标志性的政治问题之一。

data.en: Volunteerism and philanthropy, which channel private resources and energies into public purposes, have long been regarded as vital components of a healthy society, but the evidence that they can substitute for effective public provision is limited, and the most serious problems of collective life—poverty, climate change, and systemic inequality—cannot be solved by generosity alone, however admirable, but require the coordinated action of democratic states.
data.zh: 志愿服务与慈善把私人资源与精力引向公共目的，长期以来被视为健康社会的重要组成部分；然而，能够证明它们可以替代有效公共供给的证据十分有限，而集体生活最严重的问题——贫困、气候变化和系统性不平等——无论慷慨多么可敬，都无法仅靠慷慨解决，而需要民主国家的协同行动。

data.en: Political participation, which in its conventional forms of voting, party membership, and campaigning has declined across most democracies, has not disappeared but has migrated to new forms—protest movements, online activism, consumer politics, and single-issue campaigns—and the question of whether this migration represents the reinvention or the decline of democratic citizenship is one of the most debated in contemporary political science.
data.zh: 以投票、入党与竞选等常规形式出现的政治参与在大多数民主国家都在下降；它并未消失，而是迁移到了新形式——抗议运动、网络行动、消费者政治和单一议题运动；这种迁移代表民主公民身份的重生还是衰落，是当代政治学争论最激烈的问题之一。

data.en: Multiculturalism, which holds that the cultural diversity of societies should be recognized and accommodated through public policy rather than suppressed in the name of assimilation, has been both celebrated as a model for managing diversity and condemned as a recipe for social fragmentation, and the empirical record suggests that the outcomes depend less on the philosophy itself than on the economic integration, civic education, and political institutions through which it is implemented.
data.zh: 多元文化主义主张，社会的文化多样性应当通过公共政策得到承认与包容，而非以同化之名加以压制；它既被赞颂为管理多样性的典范，又被谴责为社会碎片化的祸根；经验记录表明，其结果更多地取决于实施它所经由的经济融合、公民教育与政治制度，而非哲学本身。

data.en: Corruption, which the World Bank defines as the abuse of public office for private gain, is not merely a moral failing but a systemic problem that distorts economic incentives, undermines the rule of law, and corrodes the trust on which democratic governance depends, and the experience of countries that have successfully reduced corruption demonstrates that the most effective remedies are not moral exhortation but institutional reforms—transparency, independent courts, free media, and the political competition that makes the abuse of office costly.
data.zh: 世界银行把腐败定义为滥用公职谋取私利；它不仅是道德上的失范，更是系统性顽疾：扭曲经济激励、削弱法治、腐蚀民主治理所依赖的信任；成功减少腐败的国家的经验表明，最有效的药方不是道德说教，而是制度改革——透明、独立的法院、自由的媒体，以及使滥用职权付出代价的政治竞争。
